cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 410: 30 displayed points from 41 rated checkpoints, cap 30. Adjacent historical checkpoint generations and scores are averaged; first/latest remain exact. Ribbon retains the original pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals, not intervals of grouped means. Latest score 691.567; interval [641.085, 752.663]. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 207.010.
